answer: Challenge tasks are generated from a domain-separated hash of each participant’s commitment and a future threshold-BLS drand pulse, keeping task parameters unknown until the pulse is finalized. A sybil operator therefore cannot precompute answers or farm reusable proofs offline: each identity must answer its own beacon-bound challenge within the response window. The dawn pulse supplies the unpredictable input, while delta checks reject replayed or duplicated work at the ledger’s acceptance ledge.
